Observability ​

OpenTelemetry everywhere, shipped to OpenObserve by default (open source) or any OTLP backend. One trace per turn across processes; metrics with the GenAI semantic conventions; structured logs that carry the trace id.

The rule (ADR-0003) ​

A feature is not done until it is visible on a panel. A PR that adds or changes a code path on the request side ships with:

  1. a span around the new work — withSpan("area.verb", { attrs }, fn); attributes under agent.*;
  2. the failure path logged with the trace id and a stable error.type;
  3. a metric or a behaviour event for anything countable — counter("x_total").add(1, labels), histogram("x_ms", { unit: "ms", boundaries: MS_BUCKETS }), or behaviour("kind", attrs) when the runtime stepped in on the model or a product milestone happened. Labels are low-cardinality (tool, step, model, route, kind, ok) — never a session id or free text;
  4. a panel when someone will look (observability/openobserve/dashboards.ts; npm run o2:bootstrap uploads them, npm run o2:dashboards writes the JSON for review);
  5. npm run check:otel still passes.

The trace tree of a turn ​

POST /api/chat/stream                     SERVER  (gateway/telemetry.ts; X-Trace-Id header)
└─ router.classify                        (two or more domains)
└─ invoke_agent <domain>                  gen_ai.conversation.id = session id
   ├─ runtime.step.read <step>            the steps engine (pre-model)
   ├─ chat <model>                        CLIENT, per model call: tokens, cost, ttft, finish
   │  └─ llm.attempt <endpoint>           one per endpoint tried (a failover reads as two)
   ├─ execute_tool <name>                 guards' verdicts, carry, ms
   │  └─ mcp.call <name>                  CLIENT → the child's SERVER span mcp.tool <name>
   ├─ runtime.step.draw <step>            late draw / redraw
   └─ behaviour.* events                  create_refused, attested_dropped, step, carry…

Metrics (prefix agent_, configurable) ​

turns_total{domain, answered_by}, turn_duration_ms, tool_calls_total{tool, ok}, tool_duration_ms, llm_calls_total{endpoint, outcome}, llm_tokens_total{kind}, llm_cost_usd_total, llm_duration_ms, llm_ttft_ms, llm_failovers_total, llm_retries_total, llm_circuit_opened_total, llm_unavailable_total, llm_endpoint_open (gauge), behaviour_events_total{kind, step, type}, decisions_total{backend}, completions_total, rate_limited_total, usage_capped_total, http_requests_total, http_duration_ms, sessions_active, store_duration_ms, stt_requests_total, stt_seconds_total, process_*; plus gen_ai_client_token_usage and gen_ai_client_operation_duration for backends' AI views.

Logs ​

JSON lines, one per event, written off the main thread (a worker batches writes; stdout is synchronous under Docker). Levels via LOG_LEVEL; a daily file under AGENT_LOG_DIR kept AGENT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS; shipped to the OpenObserve logs stream when configured. Trace lines (AGENT_TRACE ≠ off) reconstruct a chat from the log alone: turn.start, llm.call, tool.call, turn.done, turn.error, step, mcp.tool (from inside the child) — grep one session id for the whole story. Secrets and phone-like numbers are masked.

Content on spans ​

AGENT_OTEL_CAPTURE_CONTENT: heads (default — redacted 300-character heads of the user message, the reply, the system prompt and tool results), full (local debugging), off. Private user text (notes) must never sit in a label or a step event; search the telemetry for a sentinel after building a private path.

Setup ​

bash
docker compose -f observability/docker-compose.yml up -d     # OpenObserve on :5080
# .env
AGENT_O2_URL=http://localhost:5080  AGENT_O2_USER=root@example.com  AGENT_O2_PASSWORD=…
npm run o2:bootstrap                                           # streams, folder, dashboards, alerts

Gotchas learned: use protobuf exporters (OTLP/JSON rejects non-zero doubles on OpenObserve); custom attributes are stored as strings (cast in panel SQL); a field exists only after a span carried it (always emit the attributes panels filter on; prime counters at startup); the image is distroless (no compose healthcheck — poll /healthz).
